description: CSV diff (row and cell changes) — Compare two CSV files and get exactly what changed: rows added, rows removed, and cell-level changes for rows that match on a key column (auto-picks a unique id-like column, or pass key=, comma-separated for composite keys). Also reports columns added/removed, changes per column, and a verdict IDENTICAL / MINOR / CHANGED / MAJOR. Numbers compare numerically (1.00 = 1); optional tolerance= for numeric drift, ignore= columns to skip, ignoreCase=true, limit= rows listed (default 100, counts are always complete). Handles quoted fields, tabs, semicolons and pipes. Without a unique key it falls back to whole-row comparison. Up to 20,000 rows per file. Offline, nothing stored. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_csv_diff
